entries.58ccd32ce8b3a959: This business division handles facilities and businesses that form the foundation of society, such as aircraft, railways, airports, industrial parks, urban development and ships. Principal affiliates include consolidated subsidiaries such as Sojitz Aerospace Co., Ltd., Japcon Co., Ltd., Phenix Jet International, LLC and Long Duc Investment Co., Ltd., and equity-method affiliates Somec Corporation, PT. Puradelta Lestari Tbk and UGL Transport Holdings Pty Ltd., with 49 consolidated subsidiaries and 15 equity-method affiliates (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥121,366 million (previous year: ¥81,891 million), and net profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥15,506 million (previous year: ¥12,206 million). Revenue in this segment increased due to higher defense-related transactions. Effective April 1, 2025, the company group changed the classification of its reportable segments by reorganizing this segment and part of the business areas of Energy & Healthcare, and the figures for the previous year are prepared on the basis of the revised classification. The number of employees is 1,218.

Ltd., and the equity-method affiliates Metal One Corporation and Japan Alumina Associates (Australia) Pty. Ltd. entries.89ef5d3f16e6a3f1: This business division is engaged across a broad range of energy and machinery businesses, from renewable energy and gas-fired power generation, energy efficiency services, oil, gas and LNG, nuclear-related business, telecommunications towers and healthcare such as hospital PPP, to industrial machinery, bearings, automotive parts, marine machinery and plants. Principal affiliates include consolidated subsidiaries such as Sojitz Machinery Co., Ltd., Sojitz Mirai Power Co., Ltd., Starwind Offshore GmbH, Sojitz Global Investment B.V., McClure Company and Freestate Electric, LLC, and equity-method affiliates LNG Japan Co., Ltd. and Qualitas Medical Limited; there are 141 consolidated subsidiaries and 34 equity-method affiliates, the most of any segment (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥348,457 million (previous year: ¥194,755 million), and net profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥31,932 million (previous year: ¥22,561 million). Revenue in this segment increased due to the new consolidation of energy efficiency-related businesses and an increase in transactions. Effective April 1, 2025, the company group changed the classification of its reportable segments by reorganizing this segment and part of the business areas of Aerospace & Social Infrastructure, and the figures for the previous year are prepared on the basis of the revised classification. The number of employees is 3,766.
